channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: Busan Metropolitan City: Open Call for Land / Ecological Art on Eulsukdo
item.description: Busan Metropolitan City, Urban Parks Division · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · One proposal selected. Artwork support KRW 380,000,000 (approx. EUR 235,000) plus artist fee KRW 20,000,000 (approx. EUR 12,500). No entry fee indicated.

item.title: Experimenter: Generator Cooperative Art Production Fund (rolling)
item.description: Experimenter, with its cooperative of artists and supporters · deadline Rolling / undated · Production bursaries of up to INR 150,000 (1.5 lakhs); one bursary per artist per year, funds disbursed within 30 days of selection. No application fee.

item.title: 2027 LOOP Open Call for Exhibition Proposals (Seoul)
item.description: Alternative Space LOOP · deadline 05 Oct 2026 · Project grant of KRW 1,000,000, plus exhibition space at Alternative Space LOOP, curatorial and operational support, exhibition graphic design and promotion, and use of LOOP's available equipment. 1-2 individuals or teams are selected. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Fellowship 2028 (Chengdu)
item.description: A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Fully funded fellowship: private studio and accommodation, round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget, and a production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for materials and production (excluding living expenses). No application fee.

item.title: culture360 / ASEF: Call for Content, Arts in the Wake of AI
item.description: Asia-Europe Foundation (ASEF), culture360.ASEF.org · deadline 29 Sep 2026 · SGD 250 fee per commissioned article, podcast or video interview. Up to two proposals per application, of which at most one is selected. No application fee.

item.title: Peripheral Acts Edition 2: Leaning Out (UAE balcony residency)
item.description: Peripheral Acts, conceptualised and hosted by Shazia Salam and Priyanka Mehra · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · AED 1,000 artist commission fee plus AED 1,500 production budget per artist. Three artists commissioned. No application fee.
